examples.ar: زُيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ حُبُّ الشَّهَوَاتِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ وَالْبَنِينَ وَالْقَنَاطِيرِ الْمُقَنْطَرَةِ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ.
examples.en: Beautified for people is the love of that which they desire - of women and sons, heaped-up sums of gold and silver.
Unquestionably, by the remembrance of God do hearts find peace.
Mental exercises develop the child's intelligence.

examples.ar: أَظْهَرَ الطَّالِبُ ذَوْقًا عَالِيًا فِي الحِوَارِ مَعَ مُعَلِّمِهِ.
examples.en: The student showed high politeness in dialogue with his teacher.

examples.ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا.
examples.en: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and the excess [committed] in our affairs.

examples.ar: نَحْتَفِظُ بِالذِّكْرَيَاتِ الجَمِيلَةِ فِي صُوَرٍ قَدِيمَةٍ.
examples.en: We keep beautiful memories in old photos.
